label: Audit Finding Follow-Up
description: Tracks and assesses the remediation status of outstanding audit findings. Evaluates management's actions against agreed remediation plans and identifies overdue or inadequate responses.

guidedInputs.label: Outstanding findings and management responses
guidedInputs.description: Paste or describe the findings, agreed management actions, target dates, and current status reported by management.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., Finding 1: EDD process gap (Critical, due 31 Jan 2025) — Management reported: new system workflow implemented. Finding 2: TM alert investigation SLA (High, due 28 Feb 2025) — Management reported: SLA extended due to staffing. Finding 3: Training completion (Medium, due 30 Apr 2025) — No update received...

guidedInputs.label: Current review date
guidedInputs.description: The date as of which remediation status is being assessed.

guidedInputs.label: Evidence provided by management (if any)
guidedInputs.description: Summarise what documentary evidence or demonstrations management has provided to support completion claims.
guidedInputs.placeholder: e.g., System screenshots for Finding 1, training attendance records provided for Finding 3, no evidence for Findings 2, 4, and 5.

guidedInputs.label: Overdue escalation threshold
guidedInputs.description: When should an overdue finding trigger escalation?

options.label: Critical and High rated findings only
